title: Envoy of Joy a #PoetryPort Poem #smallpoems #writingcommunity
summary: Like a decoy of Troy but an envoy of joy deploy toys as enjoyable ploys for the real McCoys with coy thoughts mixing divisions of flamboyance and clairvoyance an epoxy of unorthodoxy gluing smiles by spewing against trials found in a fragile docile lifestyle
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Like a decoy
of Troy
but an envoy
of
   joy
deploy
  toys
as enjoyable
ploys for the
real McCoys
with coy thoughts
mixing divisions
of flamboyance and clairvoyance
an epoxy
of
unorthodoxy
gluing smiles
by spewing against
trials found in
a fragile docile
lifestyle
